obfuscation_indicators: fair value sometimes difficult and subjective
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively transparent and quantitatively detailed, including loan concentrations, nonperforming assets, charge-offs, and allowance metrics. Credit trends appear generally favorable, but the company highlights meaningful exposure to real estate markets, interest rates, borrower concentration, and subjective loss and fair-value estimates. Repeated reliance on management judgments and conditional language limits certainty regarding future credit costs.
